components.name: button
components.title: Sakuga Button
components.description: A button that reacts like an anime impact frame: it squashes when pressed, inverts for one frame on release, and a burst goes off behind it with clouds and ドン!. A secondary variant is quieter. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-button>.
components.docs: Sakuga Button is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/button.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-button>Confirm</sakuga-button> (variant="secondary" for the quiet one). Listen for click; call el.done() when the action worked to land a check on it. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

components.name: toggle
components.title: Sakuga Toggle
components.description: A switch whose flip is 43 painted frames: the knob smears across, slams into the end, throws up a splash, and the track floods and settles. The frames are inside the file (about 500 KB). One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-toggle>.
components.docs: Sakuga Toggle is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/toggle.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-toggle label="Notifications"></sakuga-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

components.name: slider
components.title: Sakuga Slider
components.description: A range slider whose thumb stretches and lags on a spring, with cumulus rolling up behind a fast drag and a crescent thrown ahead on release. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-slider>.
components.docs: Sakuga Slider is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/slider.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-slider value="30" label="Volume"></sakuga-slider>, with min, max, step and unit. Read el.value; it fires input and change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Sakuga Checkbox

components.docs: Sakuga Checkbox is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/checkbox.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-checkbox>Remember me</sakuga-checkbox>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

components.name: radio
components.title: Sakuga Radio
components.description: A radio group whose picked dot springs in with a fan of wedges, two puffs and a hollow ポン. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-radio>.
components.docs: Sakuga Radio is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/radio.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-radio label="Plan"><option value="a" selected>Option A</option><option value="b">Option B</option></sakuga-radio>. Read el.value and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app
components.demo: <sakuga-radio label="Plan"><option value="a" selected>Option A</option><option value="b">Option B</option><option value="c">Option C</option></sakuga-radio>

components.name: input
components.title: Sakuga Input
components.description: A text field that kicks up a puff of dust from the caret on every key. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-input>.
components.docs: Sakuga Input is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/input.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-input label="Name" placeholder="Type something"></sakuga-input>. Read and set el.value; it fires input and change. components.name: tabs
components.title: Sakuga Tabs
components.description: Tabs where the raised tab slides to the one you pick, stretching, and lands with wedges and a puff. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-tabs>.
components.docs: Sakuga Tabs is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/tabs.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-tabs label="Sections"><option>Home</option><option>Profile</option></sakuga-tabs>. Listen for change (e.detail: index, value, label) and show the panel yourself. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

components.name: progress
components.title: Sakuga Progress
components.description: A loading bar with a storm cloud riding its leading edge, pebbles lifting off the ground and ゴゴゴゴ; at the end a burst, ドン! and a check. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-progress>.
components.docs: Sakuga Progress is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/progress.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-progress label="Loading"></sakuga-progress>, then el.set(n) with progress from 0 to 1. Listen for sakuga:done (fires once). el.reset() for the next task. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

components.name: rating
components.title: Sakuga Rating
components.description: Five stars that pop in one after another, with wedges and a hollow ポン on the last; five gets a burst. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-rating>.
components.docs: Sakuga Rating is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/rating.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-rating label="Rating"></sakuga-rating>. Read el.value (0 to 5) and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

components.name: toast
components.title: Sakuga Toast
components.description: A notification that streaks in as a smear, lands in dust with ズザッ, wobbles and leaves by shrinking. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-toast>.
components.docs: Sakuga Toast is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/toast.js with a script tag (not a module), then use Put <sakuga-toast></sakuga-toast> where toasts should appear and call el.show("Saved"). It stays for the duration attribute (2.6 s) or until el.hide(). More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Sakuga Tooltip
components.description: A help button whose hint springs out like a speech bubble, with puffs and a hollow カチッ. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-tooltip>.
components.docs: Sakuga Tooltip is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/tooltip.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-tooltip text="Helpful hint!"></sakuga-tooltip>. Opens on hover, focus and tap; Escape closes it. More: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app
